content.text: Section 18 fully meets the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a Vendor-side insurance clause that matches our preferred position line-for-line: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M (Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law, with employer's liability of USD 1M as an extra. Clause 18.2 adds reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, certificates of insurance on request, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities. Coverage runs throughout the term plus one year, as our model language requires. No deviation; nothing to redline.
